card_microsd.quote: With the lid on, cables must plug in through openings in the walls, each with room for the plug body: the mini-HDMI port and the two micro-USB ports (data and power), which are all on one long side of the board, and the microSD card slot on a short end, so the card can be pushed in and out.

With the lid closed, a microSD card shall be able to be pushed in and pulled out through one opening in the end wall without touching the case, and that opening shall be no more than 1.5 mm bigger than the card access zone on any side.

plug_microusb_b.quote: With the lid closed, two micro-USB plugs (data and power) shall plug fully in at the same time through two openings in the same long wall without touching the case or each other, and each opening shall be no more than 1.5 mm bigger than the plug on any side.

plug_minihdmi.quote: With the lid closed, a mini-HDMI plug shall plug fully into the board through one opening in the long wall without touching the case, and that opening shall be no more than 1.5 mm bigger than the plug on any side.
